claim: new run: pi05_base initialization, 60 clean spread-layout episodes, 25000 state-on JAX LoRA updates, save every 3000 TrainState steps

resource_policy.current_admission: passes the 100 MiB margin at the final 2026-10-28 resource check; recheck immediately before launch
resource_policy.memory_fraction: computed per device from measured whole-process demand, measured JAX pool peak, 100 MiB free margin, and the tightest selected card
resource_policy.containers: exact-name registry only; no broad prefix/label cleanup

initialisation.freeze_rule: Pinned OpenPI Pi0Config.get_freeze_filter(): freeze .*llm.* except .*llm.*_1.* (action expert) and except .*lora.*; SigLIP image tower and action/time projections stay trainable

trainable_groups.language_backbone: Gemma 2B original weights frozen; attn and ffn LoRA adapters trainable
trainable_groups.action_expert: Gemma 300M non-LoRA variant, full kernel and bias trainable
trainable_groups.projections: action_in_proj, action_out_proj, time_mlp_in, time_mlp_out full kernel and bias trainable

devices.policy: probe 2-card and 4-card candidates with the real global batch; select from measured peak memory and throughput

capacity_probe.demand_probe: clean60 prepare-only attempt 31 (FSDP4, global batch 8, 3 optimizer updates, no checkpoint)
capacity_probe.evidence: private prepare-only probe report; promoted into ready evidence after v3 rebinding
capacity_probe.selection_status: FSDP4 selected after the user changed the required free-memory margin to 100 MiB; full checkpoint save/restore probe passed

devices.rejected_alternative: 4 cards with fsdp_devices=2 measured 3.8 s/update, slower than fsdp_devices=4; 2 physical cards with fsdp_devices=2 exhausted memory in forward_backward (needed a further 4.25 GiB on top of a 16.4 GiB resident pool)
devices.fsdp_devices: set at launch from --fsdp-devices; equals the selected device count unless a probe shows a smaller replica is faster
devices.batch_semantics: TrainConfig.batch_size=8 is global; the measured loader assigns 2 unique samples to each of 4 devices (8 total), not 32 and not a replicated batch of 8 per device
devices.jax_preallocate: per selected device, from that device's measured free memory minus the registered margin; the tightest device binds the fraction
devices.historical_estimate_invalid: the 52.15M trainable parameters and 15-20 GiB from the LoRA-only E4-T run do not apply to this scope; measured footprint is ~16.3 GiB per card of the four

data.statistics: 48 train episodes only; recompute for the new dataset
data.sample_weighting: clean episodes equal; eligible windows equal within each episode

checkpointing.orbax_directory_offset: directory name is loop index; actual TrainState.step is recorded by read_train_state.py

validation_gate.activity_definition: ground-truth action max absolute per-frame change >= 0.02 deg or gripper change >= 0.05 percentage points
validation_gate.activity_threshold_provenance: floor must be re-derived from the 48 clean60 train episodes before the gate is applied; the E4-T 40-episode calibration in experiments/so101/e4t-activity-calibration.json is historical and is not reused as a clean60 result
validation_gate.fk_tcp_error_mib: not reported: the pinned OpenPI model has no SO101 FK interface and this round performs no physics rollout
validation_gate.applicability: clean-only dataset; historical recovery metrics are not applicable; no closed-loop entry is authorized by this training run

run.directory_policy: launcher creates a unique child directory named by run-id
